verdict.rationale: The only webhook evidence describes building API endpoints that receive inbound webhooks from third-party services. That is a developer building block for consuming webhooks, not documented outbound callbacks that Next.js itself emits and that subscribers can register for. The evidence shows no first-party event-subscription webhook capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Build API endpoints to securely connect with third-party services for handling auth or listening for webhooks.
